description.value: Turtle Hostel occupies a historic Victorian character house in downtown Victoria, BC, offering budget dorm beds and private rooms a short walk from the Inner Harbour, Chinatown, and multiple transit connections. As a multicultural, independently run hostel it draws long-term travellers and those island-hopping by ferry. The central location means most of Victoria's attractions are reachable on foot or by bus within minutes.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website is fully fetched and content-rich. The hostel lists 'Free Available WiFi' explicitly on the front page, confirmed by OSM internet_access=wlan. However, neither the front page, rooms, policies, nor FAQs mention bike storage, bike rooms, or any bike-specific facilities — both required cycling criteria are unconfirmed null. The FAQs explicitly state no overnight luggage storage (day-of only), and the policies note the historic building lacks an elevator, suggesting limited accessibility for loaded bikes.
concerns: No mention of bike storage, bike handling, or cycling facilities anywhere on the website or in OSM tags.
Policies note the historic building has no elevator, which may complicate moving loaded touring bikes inside.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Neither required WWC criterion (secure overnight bike storage or staff bike procedure knowledge) is mentioned anywhere on the website; a direct inquiry is needed before this listing can be included in the directory.
enrichment_extras.notes: Guest kitchen and common area confirmed on front page. Limited on-site car parking mentioned but no detail on whether this extends to covered or secure bike parking.

Luggage storage.detail: Free baggage storage provided on day of check-in and/or check-out only; website explicitly states no overnight storage
